claims.text: The initial material is a W–Cu composite containing discrete W particles or interconnected W ligaments in a Cu matrix.
A thin Ti/Ni or Ni-based coating can be deposited on W particles or ligaments by magnetron sputtering before consolidation.
The coated composite can be consolidated by spark plasma sintering.
The Ti/Ni coating promotes interfacial diffusion and chemical reaction during consolidation.
Controlled interdiffusion among the coating, W, and Cu forms a graded interfacial region.
The graded W–coating–Cu interface contains a stable intermetallic layer.
Applying a Ti/Ni coating improves interfacial bonding relative to an uncoated composite.
The graded interfacial layer reduces interfacial stress.
The coating-derived interface inhibits interfacial void formation.
The coating-derived interface prevents phase separation between W and Cu.
Suppressing interfacial defects and phase separation increases the effective thermal conductivity relative to an untreated W–Cu composite.
The coated composite will have fewer interfacial voids and less phase separation after high-temperature cycling and irradiation than the untreated composite.
The coated composite will maintain or increase thermal conductivity under high-temperature cycling and irradiation relative to the untreated composite.
Untreated W–Cu composites under comparable processing and service conditions exhibit significant phase separation and interfacial void formation that reduces thermal conductivity.
The intervention is applicable under service conditions relevant to joints between W-based plasma-facing materials and Cu-based cooling components.
Nonoptimal coating thickness or composition can compromise formation and performance of the graded interface.
Excessive diffusion during extended irradiation can degrade the designed graded interface.

contradictions.description: The main hypothesis and mechanism require enhanced or improved thermal conductivity, and the falsification rule treats failure to improve it as falsifying, whereas the predicted outcome permits merely maintaining thermal conductivity.
